summary: Black Hills Corporation filed an 8-K to provide historical financials of NorthWestern Energy and pro forma combined financials for its pending all-stock merger with NorthWestern. The Merger Agreement, entered August 18, 2025, was unanimously approved by both boards. The deal is subject to state regulatory approvals and FERC clearance. No deal terms (price per share, premium) are stated. The filing is a procedural update to an announced acquisition, not a new event. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions.
